# Synthetic M2 mail fixtures

`mail.jsonl` and `pid.json` are synthetic, de-identified protocol examples
from the written M2 plan and the 2026-10-31 experiment note. They are not
live captures. Replace/augment with the M2-0 spike fixtures before enabling
the feature by default. The unverified aspects include queue-operation
content shape, uuid propagation, subagent transcript paths and hook shape.
